profile.description:
稳健复利：BTC/ETH/美股联动

6年实战，穿越牛熊。擅长利用美股与加密盘面时间差，捕捉趋势共振机会。

策略核心： 右侧顺势交易，单笔亏损封顶4%，盈亏比≥3:1。历史最大回撤＜15%，胜率约65%。

风控铁律： 强制止损，单日连亏2单即停盘，拒绝扛单与情绪化交易。

跟单须知： 适合追求中长线稳健增长者。建议按自身风险承受力设置比例，预留20%保证金。
profile.descTranslate: Steady Compound Interest: 6 years of practical experience in BTC/ETH/US stock market correlation, navigating bull and bear markets. Skilled at leveraging the time difference between US stock and cryptocurrency markets to capture trend convergence opportunities. Core Strategy: Right-side trend-following trading, single-trade loss capped at 4%, profit/loss ratio ≥ 3:1. Historical maximum drawdown < 15%, win rate approximately 65%. Ironclad Risk Management Rules: Mandatory stop-loss, trading halted after two consecutive losing trades in a single day; no holding onto losing positions or emotional trading. Copy Trading Notes: Suitable for those seeking steady medium- to long-term growth. It is recommended to set the percentage according to your own risk tolerance and reserve 20% margin.
